collection.title: Skoda Octavia Estate 2004 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Skoda Octavia Estate Mk2 2004 to 2012 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Side Pin arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Octavia, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
